## Brief

An upbeat indie-leaning pop song about the first weeks in a new city: the narrator has a key, a map, and a borrowed address but nobody who says their name yet. The tone is hopeful rather than lonely; the chorus should land as a promise to stay long enough to be known. Keep the images concrete (bus routes, market stalls, a photo pinned to a wall) and avoid naming any real city.
